Chess piece artwork ("Cburnett" set)

Author: Colin M.L. Burnett (Wikimedia user "Cburnett"), with later minor
revisions uploaded to the same Commons file pages by Antonsusi, TomFryers,
Apathor, Edemaine, Cyco130 and Smasongarrison.

Source files (Wikimedia Commons, current revisions as downloaded 2026-09-27):
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chess_klt45.svg  (and _qlt45, _rlt45,
  _blt45, _nlt45, _plt45, _kdt45, _qdt45, _rdt45, _bdt45, _ndt45, _pdt45)
